about: Public Office files of the benchmark corpus, fetched by `corpus/build.py --real` into .cache/corpus/real/<id>/ (office/ and pdf/, one folder per download) and checked against sha256; never committed. Chosen 2026-10-31: produced by Microsoft Word or PowerPoint (docProps/app.xml, cross-checked with the PDF twin's Creator), permissive licence, no personal data beyond public enquiry lines and author credits. pdf: the same publication's PDF from the same page; route = office-native (Word/PowerPoint 'Save as PDF' on Windows: the PDF's Producer and Creator name the Office application), office-mac-quartz (Office for Mac lays the pages out and macOS Quartz writes the PDF; Creator names the application), acrobat-pdfmaker (PowerPoint lays out, Adobe's PDFMaker add-in writes the PDF). pages_app_xml is what Word stored when it last saved, and can be stale (the two Social Impacts files say 1). band: short 2-10 pages, medium 11-80, long 81+ (by the PDF twin's pages).
